map.由每期现金流与贴现率求永续年金现值 使用指南: Deriving the Perpetuity Present Value from Per-Period Cash Flow and Discount Rate User Guide
map.永续年金现值计算器，输入每期现金流与贴现率按 PV=C/r 求永续年金现值，用于: Perpetuity Present Value Calculator, entering the per-period cash flow and discount rate and using PV = C/r for the present value of a perpetuity, used in valuation and dividend models.
map.PV=C÷r，C 每期现金流、r 贴现率，适用于永久国债、优先股等无限期现金流。: PV = C / r, where C is the per-period cash flow and r the discount rate, applicable to indefinite cash flows such as perpetual government bonds and preferred stock. In reality these often include call or default provisions, and a strict perpetuity exists only in the model.
map.填写「每期现金流 C (元)」。: Enter the per-period cash flow C (CNY).
map.优先股、永久债券等无限期现金流估值。: Valuing indefinite cash flows such as preferred stock and perpetual bonds.
map.用股息贴现模型估计股票内在价值。: Estimate a stock's intrinsic value with a dividend discount model.
map.对「固定年付、永续」类负债定价。: Prices liabilities of the "fixed annual payment, perpetual" type.
map.每年 100、贴现率 5% 的永续现值: Present value of 100 per year at a 5% discount rate
map.：PV=C÷r=100÷0.05=2,000 元。这是该永续现金流在当前利率下的: PV = C/r = 100/0.05 = 2,000 CNY. This is the theoretical price of that perpetual cash flow at the current rate.
map.由每期付款、利率与期数求期初年金现值: Annuity due present value from the per-period payment, rate and term count
map.由免税品种收益率与税率求税后等效收益率: After-tax equivalent yield from a tax-exempt yield and the tax rate
map.永续年金现实中存在吗？: Does a perpetuity exist in reality?
map.近似存在：英国 Consols 永久国债、优先股固定股息、某些年金产品。严格无限: Approximates exist: UK Consols perpetuities, fixed preferred dividends and some annuity products. A strictly indefinite cash flow holds only in the model, while real products usually carry call or default provisions.
map.增长率不为 0 时怎么办？: What if the growth rate is not zero?
map.用增长永续年金 PV=C÷(r−g)，要求 r>g。这是优先股/股息模型中「永续: For growing perpetuities use PV = C/(r-g), which requires r > g. This is the "perpetual plus growth" extension in preferred stock and dividend models.
